intent: Deliver evopilot-harness 4.7.0 governed multi-Pack, Project Ontology, Organization lifecycle, immutable Artifact Set, deterministic projections, and ProjectOntologySkill while preserving all validated v4.6.0 capabilities and authority boundaries.
objective: Add a cumulative, fail-closed, non-executable professional Pack ecosystem and independently governed Project Ontology lifecycle that resolves exact Pack versions into immutable project-bound semantic assets for read-only consumers without merging authoring, review, approval, publication, installation, activation, runtime, or release authority.

evidence.authority: user-approved EvoPilot-series semantic design convergence Roadmap revision; authorizes Target drafting and review only
exact approval and completed validation of the cumulative v4.6.0 predecessor Target; no v4.7 or release authority
validated v4.6.0 capability and 225-criterion cumulative acceptance baseline
accepted module and product boundary; any boundary change requires separate governance

include: an extension of the stable v4.5 Taxonomy envelope, namespaces, canonical snapshots, and context bindings with versioned Domain, Product, Organization, and DomainHarnessPack resources, imports, precedence, equivalence, replacement, deprecation, and fail-closed merge semantics
DomainHarnessPack scaffolding, linting, validation, dependency inspection, compatibility declaration, installation, update, rollback, and documentation tooling
separate editable drafts and immutable resolved publication snapshots with approval, publication, and Evolution Context activation as independent actions
base-digest, optimistic-concurrency, conflict-set, atomic-publication-set, semantic-version and dependency-propagation, migration, and rollback contracts
separate community, domain-team, and private Organization Pack roots with explicit provenance, trust, ownership, reviewer, approver, and publisher roles
versioned professional benchmark and Gold Case packages, Pack quality levels, optional signing, and reproducible certification evidence
reference financial, CRM, ERP, and other example Packs that demonstrate authoring patterns without claiming universal business authority

independently versioned DomainOntologyPack, ProductOntologyPack, OrganizationOntologyPack, and ProjectOntologyOverlay resources plus ProjectOntologyProposal/v1 and immutable fully resolved ResolvedProjectOntologySnapshot/v1
ProjectOntologyArtifactSet/v1 with manifest, canonical snapshot, provenance, project binding, lock, dependency, and digest closure
deterministic applicable YAML, OWL, RDF Turtle, JSON-LD, bounded SWRL, and SHACL projections with explicit non-applicability instead of fabrication
deterministic ProjectOntologySkill/v1 compilation as the Agent-facing access and guidance form rather than a sole truth store
ExternalSemanticEvidenceAdapter/v1 for read-only provenance-preserving import that remains inactive Evidence
complete cumulative replay of all 225 v4.6.0 current and inherited acceptance criteria on the exact v4.7 Candidate
exactly RC01-RC05 top-level designated-human WorkBuddy journeys with complete independent machine variants and NO_REGRESSION
exclude: general-purpose graph database, arbitrary executable Pack, unbounded OWL or SWRL inference, automatic imported-vocabulary activation, or live cross-organization authority
v4.8 incremental affected-subgraph reasoning, external reasoners, federated discovery, semantic indexes, or large-Catalog performance claims
EvoPilot Runtime or Expert implementation, Dashboard implementation, cloud service, container distribution, automatic approval, automatic publication, or Release authorization
compatibility reset, removal of any v4.6 capability, or weakening of designated-human WorkBuddy closure

compatibilityPolicy.rule: Every validated v4.6.0 product capability, safety invariant, authority boundary, and current or inherited acceptance criterion remains applicable and must pass on v4.7.0; no artifact or protocol reset is declared.

acceptance.criterion: Define independently versioned DomainOntologyPack/v1, ProductOntologyPack/v1, OrganizationOntologyPack/v1, ProjectOntologyOverlay/v1, and DomainHarnessPack/v1 resources with canonical identifiers, namespaces, imports, precedence, equivalence, replacement, deprecation, provenance, and fail-closed merge semantics.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Schemas, validators, canonicalization fixtures, positive and negative dependency graphs, and digest-stability evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Separate editable Pack and Project Ontology drafts from immutable resolved publication snapshots so Draft, apply, Review, Approval, Publication, installation, Evolution Context activation, successor, rollback, and deprecation remain independently authorized state transitions.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: State-machine tests, authorization matrix, immutable snapshot evidence, and rejection evidence for skipped or conflated transitions.

acceptance.criterion: Implement base-digest and optimistic-concurrency checks, explicit conflict sets, atomic publication sets, semantic-version and dependency propagation, migration plans, successor links, and deterministic rollback for Pack and Project Ontology lifecycle operations.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Concurrent-update, conflict, partial-publication, migration, dependency propagation, and rollback fixtures bound to exact artifact digests.

acceptance.criterion: Provide deterministic Pack scaffolding, linting, validation, dependency inspection, compatibility declaration, installation, update, rollback, documentation, benchmark, Gold Case, quality-level, optional-signing, and certification tooling without executing Pack content.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: CLI, MCP, Digital Expert, package, fixture, and negative-path evidence proving declarative non-executable operation.

acceptance.criterion: Separate community, domain-team, and private Organization roots with explicit provenance, trust context, ownership, author, reviewer, approver, and publisher roles, and prevent private Organization material from leaking into public or community roots.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: RBAC, root-isolation, provenance, export, publication, and adversarial non-leakage evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Bind every quality or certification claim to exact Pack, benchmark, Gold Case, algorithm, policy, toolchain, signer when present, and reproducible evidence versions; optional signing never creates automatic trust.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Reproducible certification records, digest mismatch rejection, signer-absence behavior, and non-activation assertions.

acceptance.criterion: Create ProjectOntologyProposal/v1 and deterministically resolve the selected versioned Pack set and ProjectOntologyOverlay into one immutable ResolvedProjectOntologySnapshot/v1 with complete provenance, conflict, dependency, authority, and project-context closure.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Proposal, review, resolution, conflict, abstention, immutable snapshot, and project-binding evidence across representative professional Sources.

acceptance.criterion: Publish ProjectOntologyArtifactSet/v1 with a manifest, canonical snapshot, provenance, exact project binding, lock, dependency graph, projection inventory, and digest closure, while keeping publication separately authorized from approval and activation.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Artifact-set manifest validation, tamper rejection, independent approval/publication/activation checks, and fresh-install readback evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Generate deterministic applicable projections from one resolved snapshot to human-readable YAML, OWL, RDF Turtle, JSON-LD, bounded SWRL, and SHACL, and declare a projection non-applicable with reasons instead of fabricating content.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Golden projection fixtures, canonical round-trip comparisons, explicit non-applicability cases, bounded-rule validation, and digest closure.

acceptance.criterion: Compile deterministic ProjectOntologySkill/v1 as an Agent-facing access and guidance projection bound to the canonical snapshot and Artifact Set, never as the sole truth store or an executable authority surface.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Skill compilation, stale-binding rejection, read-only Host consumption, restart, and truth-source separation evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Implement ExternalSemanticEvidenceAdapter/v1 for read-only, provenance-preserving import from catalogs, vocabularies, RDF or OWL sources, and knowledge graphs while keeping imported content inactive Evidence until explicit governed user action incorporates it.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Adapter fixtures, provenance retention, offline replay, hostile-input rejection, and assertions that import cannot activate, override, approve, or publish.

acceptance.criterion: Preserve every validated v4.6.0 grounding, professional reasoning, semantic compatibility, Harness Eligibility, Harness evolution, approval, separate publication, Host-conformance, recovery, and safe-close capability while adding the governed multi-Pack and Project Ontology lifecycle.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Complete 225-item inherited replay plus current impact closure and NO_REGRESSION on the exact v4.7 candidate.

acceptance.criterion: Pack installation is declarative, non-executable, digest-pinned, conflict-previewed, and independently authorized for the exact root, project, version set, and dependency closure.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Real-user installation journey and machine variants covering valid, conflicting, stale, unsigned, and unauthorized Packs.

acceptance.criterion: Unresolved namespace collisions, cyclic imports, incompatible overrides, partial publication, missing dependencies, silent shadowing, stale base digests, or ambiguous precedence fail closed with finite repair actions.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Negative matrix for every failure class with immutable conflict evidence and zero partial mutation.

acceptance.criterion: Author, reviewer, approver, and publisher duties remain explicit and separable across Pack, Proposal, Artifact Set, Skill, installation, activation, successor, rollback, and deprecation workflows.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Role-separated real-host workflows, denial cases, audit linkage, and no inferred human authority.

acceptance.criterion: Private Organization Packs and derived private semantic material cannot leak into public or community Catalog roots, exports, projections, Skills, logs, diagnostics, benchmarks, or certification evidence.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Cross-root isolation and adversarial disclosure tests across every public projection and diagnostic surface.

acceptance.criterion: Quality and certification claims remain reproducible advisory evidence bound to exact inputs and never automatically establish trust, approval, publication, installation, activation, or release authority.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Digest-bound certification comparison, changed-input invalidation, and authority non-escalation evidence.

acceptance.criterion: An ordinary user can evolve an unknown Source into a governed project semantic map, repair unresolved semantics, review and separately publish an immutable Artifact Set and Skill, and perform successor rollback without hidden state or authority jumps.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Five designated-human top-level journeys and independent machine variants with finite next actions and full audit closure.

acceptance.criterion: One resolved snapshot produces deterministic applicable YAML, OWL, RDF Turtle, JSON-LD, bounded SWRL, SHACL, and ProjectOntologySkill outputs whose manifests and digests remain mutually closed and project-bound.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Cross-format closure, non-applicability, tamper, restart, and cross-Host consistency evidence.

acceptance.criterion: A separately published ProjectOntologyArtifactSet and ProjectOntologySkill can be supplied read-only to an EvoPilot consumer without granting EvoPilot Pack authoring, mutation, review, approval, publication, installation, or activation authority.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Boundary contract, immutable supply handoff, read-only consumer validation, and mutation-denial evidence; runtime Goal Loop implementation remains outside this Target.

acceptance.criterion: Exactly RC01 through RC05 cover the ordinary-human v4.7 experience, while independent machine variants cover all current criteria, all 225 inherited criteria, security, restart, rollback, cross-Host consistency, and NO_REGRESSION.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Frozen runbooks, variant matrix, inherited replay ledger, WorkBuddy final range declaration, and aggregate closure report.

acceptance.criterion: v4.7.0 does not introduce executable marketplace plugins, automatic Pack trust or publication, a cloud marketplace service, built-in universal vertical expertise, general-purpose graph storage, incremental reasoning, federated discovery, or unbounded OWL or SWRL inference.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Package and public-surface inspection plus negative API, CLI, MCP, UI, Catalog, and Host assertions for every exclusion.
